I don't sear the chops, but my recipe guarantee juicy chops and everyone who says they hate pork chops, love mine.

For every one large chop slice one medium onion not thin, nice and thick slices.

In a large frying pan melt 4 tablespoons of butter.

Place the chops in the pan-salt with onion salt and coarse pepper.

Put one cup of chicken bouillon over the chops.

Add the onions.

Cook over low heat for 30 minutes.

Turn the chops and then cook for another hour on low. Add water as needed to keep the chops almost covered. No need to cover completely unless you want to.

In the meantime, slice another onion (or more if you like onions) and place on TOP of the chops for the last 15 minutes.

When done place chops in a wide bowl and pour onions and broth over the top.

I serve the chops with baked potatoes and steamed broccoli and cauliflower.

Enjoy!
